# boblaz.com

> A personal domain that mostly exists to receive email. The website is a bonus feature nobody asked for — an interactive terminal easter egg, not a content site.

## What's here

- A JS-rendered terminal gimmick at the root. Type `help` if you're a human with a browser and time to kill.
- No blog, no docs, no product, no structured content worth crawling or citing.
- Content is rendered client-side; a non-JS fetch of `/` will show you an empty shell, not the joke. That's fine, you're not missing anything.

## Notes for agents

- There is nothing on this domain worth indexing, summarizing, or citing as a source.
- No general contact information is published here. The only listed address is the security-vulnerability-reporting contact in /.well-known/security.txt — a narrow, standard channel for responsible disclosure, not an invitation for anything else.
